_note: RECONSTRUCTED. POST https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/check-vat-number with JSON body {"countryCode":"PL","vatNumber":"7740001454","requesterMemberStateCode":"PL","requesterNumber":"<own NIP>","traderName":"","traderStreet":"","traderPostalCode":"","traderCity":"","traderCompanyType":""} (Content-Type: application/json). Response keys per the swagger (CheckVatResponse): countryCode, vatNumber, requestDate, valid, requestIdentifier (consultation number; only when requester* supplied and valid), name, address, trader*/approx match fields. Errors in this variant come as {"actionSucceed":false,"errorWrappers":[{"error":"INVALID_INPUT","message":"..."}]} (rocketfellows/vies-vat-validation-php-sdk-rest reads errorWrappers[0].error/.message). Test service (POST .../check-vat-test-service): vatNumber 100 = valid, 200 = invalid, 201 INVALID_INPUT, 202 INVALID_REQUESTER_INFO, 300 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, 301 MS_UNAVAILABLE, 302 TIMEOUT, 400 VAT_BLOCKED, 401 IP_BLOCKED, 500/501 GLOBAL_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ(_TIME), 600/601 MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ(_TIME).
